question.text: The pH of blood stream is maintained by a proper balance of <math> <mrow> <msub> <mtext>H</mtext> <mtext>2</mtext> </msub> <msub> <mrow> <mtext>CO</mtext></mrow> <mtext>3</mtext> </msub> </mrow> </math> and <math><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math> concentration. What volume of 5M <math><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math> solution should be mixed with 10 ml sample of blood which is 2 M in <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math> in order to maintain a pH of <math><mn>7.4</mn><mo>(</mo><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi></mrow></msub></math> for <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math> in blood is <math><mn>4.0</mn><mo>×</mo><mn>1</mn><msup><mrow><mn>0</mn></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>7</mn></mrow></msup><mo>)</mo></math> ?

solution.text:
H2CO3 in blood = 2 M
Volume of blood = 10 ml
NaHCO3=5M
Let volume of NaHCO3 used = V ml
H2CO3 in mixture =2×10v+10
NaHCO3 in mixture =5×vv+10
pH = pKa + log salt acid
7.4 = -log (4×10−7) + log5 × vv + 102 × 10v + 10
v=40 ml
